products.name: Microsoft 365 License Optimization & Reharvesting — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to optimize and reharvest Microsoft 365 licenses — measure real usage via the admin center and Graph, reclaim unused/duplicate/over-tier seats, and run an ongoing savings campaign. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop paying for Microsoft 365 licenses nobody uses

Microsoft 365 license spend quietly balloons: leavers keep their seats, users sit on E5 when E3 would do, and duplicate or unused assignments pile up where nobody is looking. This solution gives you a repeatable way to optimize and reharvest Microsoft 365 licenses — measure real usage from the Microsoft 365 admin center and Microsoft Graph, identify unused, duplicate, and over-tier assignments, reclaim them safely, and run an ongoing savings campaign.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Microsoft 365 licensing/assignment model, how usage is measured (admin center usage reports + Microsoft Graph), the reclaim/right-size/downgrade levers, and the ongoing reharvesting cycle.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID, Microsoft 365 admin/billing roles, usage reporting enabled, Graph permissions, a savings target) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: pull license inventory and usage, identify unused/duplicate/over-tier seats, validate candidates, reclaim and right-size safely, report savings, then pilot, validate, and expand into a recurring campaign.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — license inventory/usage discovery, reclaim-candidate validation, a usage and savings report, safe reclamation (remove/downgrade with -WhatIf), and a target group builder for the campaign.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Microsoft 365 license spend cut to what is actually used — unused, duplicate, and over-tier seats reclaimed safely and a recurring savings campaign in place — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • M365LIC-Discovery.ps1 — read-only Microsoft 365 license inventory (subscriptions + per-user assignments) via Microsoft Graph
    • M365LIC-Remediation.ps1 — SAFE reclamation of Microsoft 365 licenses (remove unused/duplicate, right-size over-tier). Defaults to -WhatIf
    • M365LIC-Report.ps1 — read-only usage + savings report from Microsoft 365 usage reports and sign-in data
    • M365LIC-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/populate the Entra groups for the reclamation campaign (exclusions, pilot, broad)
    • M365LIC-Validation.ps1 — read-only classification of license seats into unused / duplicate / over-tier reclaim candidates

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
